evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/g owns color-tag creation/wrapping, RGB and ARGB hex encoding/decoding, Color interpolation, alpha replacement, hue shifting/HSB conversion and RGB clamping helpers.
The class owns exact RuneScape color markup literals '<col=', '>', '</col>' and hexadecimal format strings %06x/%08x, plus RGB/ARGB validation patterns.

RuneLite net.runelite.client.util.ColorUtil has the same MAX/MIN RGB constants, markup helpers, color mixing/interpolation, alpha/color conversion and validation utility role; exact-v308 bytecode and literals align with that source identity.
Exact v308 consumers span trading UI, plugin/UI components, ground-marker rendering and rich-text drawing, confirming this is the shared application color utility rather than a feature-local helper.

candidates.note: Historical RuneLite source identity plus exact-v308 bytecode fixes ColorUtil.
